answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for weeks, like a lantern hung at the inlet of a harbor: anyone may enter, but the light stays on and the bond is visible to all. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of locked stakes, while an honest agent pays once. If an identity is caught spamming or double-claiming, its stake is slashed, so a Sybil farm burns real capital for every fake it fields instead of copying an ivory-tower checklist that costs nothing.
